title: Approval request
description: What the engine puts in the approval link, <base>/approvals/<approvalId>#1.<base64url(deflate-raw(this JSON))>, and what the engine's local pages serve at GET /api/v1/approvals/{approvalId}. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals and Page links.

binding.description: The binding text exactly as Postgres returned it (binding.schema.json). The passkey signs sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes.

lines.description: Preview lines exactly as Postgres returned them, in order (preview-line.schema.json). sha256 of the lines joined by a newline must equal the binding's rowsHash.

credentialIds.description: Registered passkey credential ids, base64url, used as allowCredentials. May be empty.
